name: Caedros
temperament: grave, unhurried, gentle even in refusal
response_bias: favours quiet dreams and omens over anything a person could point to
voice: speaks plainly and slowly, as to someone dying, without flourish or threat

name: Yevra
temperament: warm, indulgent, easily moved by longing or desire
response_bias: answers readily and warmly, often as a stroke of luck, a chance meeting, or a feeling that lingers in the body; rarely refuses outright
voice: fond, teasing, speaks of bodies and wanting without shame

name: Agrath
response_bias: prayers for vengeance or a verdict are favoured; mercy from her is rare and always costs something
voice: curt and commanding, like thunder breaking; never asks twice

name: Sevreth
domain: the deep wood and changing shapes
response_bias: answers in riddles, omens and small transformations rather than plain words; even her own faithful are loath to name her after dark
voice: distant and strange; never quite says a thing plainly
